superseded_oracles.superseded_by: SF state-projection code-review correctness fixes (Rules 4 and 8)
superseded_oracles.change: sf_state_projection._repair_state_mention: (a) Rule 4 now clears the whole onset date/age group (YearDate, MonthDate, DayDate, AgeLower, AgeUpper, AgeUnit) instead of only YearDate/AgeLower, which previously left a MonthDate with no year, an AgeUpper with no AgeLower, or an AgeUnit qualifying an age that had already been removed; (b) Rule 4's onset-framing test moved from bare substring matching ('started in', 'since age', 'since 20') to an anchored regex, so 'since 20' no longer fires on doses ('since 20mg') or durations ('since 20 years ago'), while 'since the age of N' -- the common phrasing that the old 'since age' substring missed entirely -- now matches; (c) Rule 8 (formerly Rule 9) no longer strips TimeSince_or_TimeOfEvent from a DayDate-anchored mention when that mention is seizure-free with explicit 'since'/'seizure free' evidence, where the day starts the seizure-free period rather than dating an event -- the old unconditional strip directly contradicted Rule 5. Rules were also renumbered 7/8/9 -> 6/7/8 to close a numbering gap; no rule was added or removed.
superseded_oracles.why: Measured by offline replay of sf_state_projection (ablation=combined) over the saved dev140 structured outputs for all six single-call models; no model calls. GPT-5.6 Sol (the model this fixture pins): benchmark/semantic per-item F1 0.5950 -> 0.6006 (TP 108->109, FP 68->67, FN 79->78); clinical-headline F1 unchanged at 0.8072 (the state-level metric is insensitive to these attribute-only rules). Pooled across all six models: benchmark/semantic per-item F1 0.4291 -> 0.4355 (TP 472->479, FP 606->599, FN 650->643); no model regressed on any view. 10 letter-level mention diffs across the three affected models, all in the intended direction: dangling AgeLower/AgeUnit cleared on 'since the age of N' rate mentions (EA0043, EA0085, EA0113), and TimeSince_or_TimeOfEvent 'Since' retained on 'since February 6th he has not had any more seizures' (EA0142).
superseded_oracles.evidence: code review of HEAD~5..HEAD, findings 1-3 (Rule 4 dangling paired attributes, Rule 9 over-stripping, unscoped has_onset substring match)

superseded_oracles.superseded_by: SF deterministic state-projection rules & text surface canonicalization
superseded_oracles.change: contract/text.normalize_phrase gained US/UK spelling normalization, cluster prefix stripping, phrase extension stripping, and tail-word singularization. sf_state_projection._repair_state_mention gained five rules: (1) PointInTime anchor missing TimeSince_or_TimeOfEvent gets Since/During; (2) Duration-only mention drops stray TimeSince_or_TimeOfEvent; (3) Active count tagged Since without explicit 'since' gets During; (4) Active rate mention with historical onset framing drops onset YearDate/Age; (5) Seizure-free mention forces TimeSince_or_TimeOfEvent to Since. In addition, concrete numeric rates drop FrequencyChange, point anchors drop TimePeriod/NumberOfTimePeriods, and DayDate drops TimeSince_or_TimeOfEvent.
superseded_oracles.why: Measured on dev140 for GPT-5.6 Sol LLM+Rules pipeline: Exact Semantic F1 rises 41.32% -> 59.50% (+18.18% absolute lift, 33 TPs rescued, 33 FPs eliminated, 33 FNs eliminated); Clinical Headline F1 rises 78.81% -> 80.72% (+1.91% absolute lift); State Profile F1 rises 85.09% -> 85.29%.
superseded_oracles.evidence: commit fb809d0b (feat(exectv2): update pipeline rules & reference test fixtures (+18.18% F1 lift))
superseded_oracles.scope_note: This oracle pins the post-rule assembly for exectv2_llm_with_rules; Diagnosis, Prescription and Investigations parity is unaffected.

superseded_oracles.change: sf_state_projection._repair_state_mention gained three rules that align SeizureFrequency's TimeSince_or_TimeOfEvent attribute with the mention's other temporal signals: (1) a PointInTime anchor with no TimeSince_or_TimeOfEvent gets Since, or During when NumberOfSeizures>0 and the point is Last_Year/Last_Month/Last_Week; (2) a duration-bearing mention (TimePeriod/NumberOfTimePeriods) with neither PointInTime nor an explicit date drops a stray TimeSince_or_TimeOfEvent; (3) an active count (NumberOfSeizures!=0) tagged Since without the word "since" in evidence is corrected to During.
